checked_by: T-0019, the provenance sweep under ADR-0006 decision 7
method: Read the pack's whole read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, guides/, refs/, exemplars/; research/ excluded as working notes) and compared each cited EV id against its row in registry/evidence.json. No source was re-fetched, so nothing here is a fresh licence check: every licence claim below is the ledger's own recorded value, read back. Quotation was checked three ways: every quotation-marked span in the read surface was listed and read; every enumeration or coined term that could only have come from a source was traced to the row that supplies it; and the rows whose ledger licence forbids reuse of wording were read against the prose that cites them. What this method cannot do is detect an unmarked sentence copied from a source nobody has the text of, and no claim of completeness is made on that.

quotation_concerns.resolution: Not a concern. EV-0151 is CC BY 4.0, which permits reuse with attribution, and the citation is present. Left as is.

notes: The weakest licence position after business-model-pricing, and it was already known: packs/architecture/refs/evidence-map.md carries a Licence constraints on reuse section listing the rows that are paraphrase only. Sixteen of thirty-six cited rows are unconfirmed. Ten are practitioner sites, vendor documentation and single-company engineering blogs with a copyright footer and no licence page (EV-0149, EV-0150, EV-0153, EV-0157, EV-0159, EV-0160, EV-0161, EV-0162, EV-0163, EV-0285). Three are papers read through author-hosted copies (EV-0152, EV-0154, EV-0191). The other three are documentation pages whose terms were never read: EV-0102, EV-0193 and EV-0202. The evidence map previously said the remainder were permissive or CC BY, which was untrue for EV-0102, EV-0152 and EV-0154; that sentence has been corrected in this pass. No lifted expression was found. A row marked states-none carries licence_evidence and a licence_checked date in the ledger, so somebody looked and recorded that the source states no licence. A row marked unconfirmed carries a hedged licence string and no licence_evidence, so nobody has looked. Both belong on the residual list ADR-0006 decision 7 asks for, and the difference between them is the difference between a recorded fact and a guess.
